create_generator_unit_subclass: create a GeneratorUnit subclass that implements prepare_metric_bag and process_batch for custom batch types
run_generator_task: run a Generator instance to produce model output from a DataReader with metrics and profiling
implement_process_batch: implement process_batch in a GeneratorUnit subclass to handle one batch and update the metric bag
finalize_generator_metrics: call finalize on a GeneratorUnit to compute final metrics after all batches are processed
request_generator_stop: call request_stop on a Generator to gracefully halt the generation loop mid-run
